factor_name: Intermediate Dispersion Trend-Confirmed Volatility-Scaled Residual Pullback

calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the equal-weight cross-asset daily log return to form residual returns. During elevated but not extreme cross-asset dispersion and positive lagged 60-day trend, take the lagged contrarian signal to the asset's 10-day residual shock, scaled by recent volatility. The one-day lag prevents look-ahead.

metrics.decay: 10-day forward horizon validated; alternative horizons not computed in this cycle

validation.regime_notes: No qualifying dates in 2020-2023; IC 0.10937 over 33 dates in 2024-2026, 0.07303 over 75 dates in 2027-2029, and 0.03066 over 151 dates in 2030-2032. Positive but decaying recent regime performance; use conservative ensemble weight.
